# relyance_integration_connection (Data Source)

An existing integration connection (read-only). Useful for referencing connections managed outside Terraform — e.g. gating on a browser-authorized OAuth connection's auth_status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a connection Terraform doesn't own (e.g. a browser-authorized OAuth
# vendor) — gate on its live status:
data "relyance_integration_connection" "sfdc" {
  vendor = "salesforce"
  id     = "0"
}

output "salesforce_connected" {
  value = data.relyance_integration_connection.sfdc.auth_status == "AUTH_STATUS_CONNECTED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Connection id.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor identifier, e.g. aws_s3.

### Read-Only

- `auth_status` (String) Live credential status (e.g. AUTH_STATUS_CONNECTED).
- `auth_type` (String) Configured authentication method.
- `integration_type` (String) Integration type.
- `name` (String) Display name.
